title: Detailed tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Rear large wheel -->
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="18" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="16" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="13" fill="#4a4a4a"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="9" fill="#5a5a5a"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="5" fill="#888"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="72" r="2.5" fill="#ccc"/>
  <!-- Rear wheel treads -->
  <g stroke="#666" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="62" y1="56" x2="62" y2="54"/>
    <line x1="62" y1="88" x2="62" y2="90"/>
    <line x1="46" y1="72" x2="44" y2="72"/>
    <line x1="78" y1="72" x2="80" y2="72"/>
    <line x1="50.7" y1="60.7" x2="49.3" y2="59.3"/>
    <line x1="73.3" y1="83.3" x2="74.7" y2="84.7"/>
    <line x1="73.3" y1="60.7" x2="74.7" y2="59.3"/>
    <line x1="50.7" y1="83.3" x2="49.3" y2="84.7"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Front small wheel -->
  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="10" fill="#2b2b2b"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="8.5" fill="#3a3a3a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="6.5" fill="#4a4a4a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="4" fill="#5a5a5a"/>
  <circle cx="30" cy="82" r="2" fill="#888"/>
  <!-- Front wheel treads -->
  <g stroke="#666" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round">
    <line x1="30" y1="73.5" x2="30" y2="72"/>
    <line x1="30" y1="90.5" x2="30" y2="92"/>
    <line x1="21.5" y1="82" x2="20" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="38.5" y1="82" x2="40" y2="82"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="76" x2="23" y2="75"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="88" x2="37" y2="89"/>
    <line x1="36" y1="76" x2="37" y2="75"/>
    <line x1="24" y1="88" x2="23" y2="89"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Axle bar -->
  <rect x="30" y="78" width="32" height="5" rx="2" fill="#e8a020"/>

  <!-- Tractor body main -->
  <rect x="22" y="44" width="52" height="28" rx="4" fill="#e8a020"/>
  <!-- Body highlighting -->
  <rect x="22" y="44" width="52" height="5" rx="2" fill="#f4b840"/>
  <rect x="22" y="68" width="52" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c88018"/>

  <!-- Engine hood -->
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="32" height="16" rx="3" fill="#d83828"/>
  <rect x="22" y="38" width="32" height="4" rx="2" fill="#f05040"/>
  <!-- Hood stripes -->
  <rect x="32" y="42" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#f4b840"/>
  <rect x="40" y="42" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#f4b840"/>
  <rect x="26" y="42" width="3" height="8" rx="1" fill="#f4b840"/>

  <!-- Exhaust pipe -->
  <rect x="24" y="26" width="4" height="14" rx="1.5" fill="#a05010"/>
  <rect x="23" y="23" width="6" height="4" rx="2" fill="#c06018"/>

  <!-- Grille at front -->
  <rect x="22" y="46" width="5" height="12" rx="1" fill="#f4b840"/>
  <line x1="23.5" y1="47" x2="23.5" y2="57" stroke="#c88018" stroke-width="1"/>
  <line x1="25.5" y1="47" x2="25.5" y2="57" stroke="#c88018" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Cab / cabin -->
  <rect x="44" y="22" width="28" height="26" rx="4" fill="#3068c0"/>
  <rect x="44" y="22" width="28" height="4" rx="2" fill="#5088e0"/>
  <!-- Cab window -->
  <rect x="48" y="27" width="20" height="12" rx="2" fill="#a0d8f8"/>
  <rect x="49" y="28" width="8" height="5" rx="1" fill="#c8ecff"/>
  <!-- Cab roof -->
  <rect x="43" y="18" width="30" height="6" rx="2" fill="#2050a0"/>
  <rect x="43" y="18" width="30" height="2" rx="1" fill="#5088e0"/>

  <!-- Fender over rear wheel -->
  <path d="M42 60 Q42 52 50 52 L74 52 Q80 52 80 60 L80 66 L76 66 L76 60 Q76 56 72 56 L46 56 Q44 56 44 60 L44 66 L42 66 Z" fill="#c88018"/>

  <!-- Fender over front wheel -->
  <path d="M20 76 Q20 70 26 70 L36 70 Q40 70 40 76 L40 80 L37 80 L37 77 Q37 74 34 74 L28 74 Q24 74 24 77 L24 80 L20 80 Z" fill="#c88018"/>

  <!-- Headlight -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="56" r="3.5" fill="#fff8a0"/>
  <circle cx="26" cy="56" r="2" fill="#ffec60"/>

  <!-- Steering wheel hint -->
  <circle cx="58" cy="44" r="3.5" fill="none" stroke="#2050a0" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Seat -->
  <rect x="60" y="42" width="10" height="4" rx="2" fill="#2050a0"/>
  <rect x="63" y="46" width="4" height="8" rx="1" fill="#2050a0"/>

  <!-- Front bumper -->
  <rect x="20" y="58" width="4" height="6" rx="1" fill="#a0a0a0"/>

  <!-- Small exhaust puff -->
  <circle cx="26" cy="19" r="3" fill="#d0d0d0" opacity="0.5"/>
  <circle cx="29" cy="15" r="2" fill="#d0d0d0" opacity="0.35"/>
</svg>
